content:
Nadia Cohen: Heads-up: partner wants clear security checklist for marketplace submission. We need SOC proof options, pen-test rules, SI Q&A, upload naming + redaction. Can we make a one-page checklist + a short FAQ?
Ethan Park: Yes. Quick rules: accept (1) current SOC2 attestation PDF, (2) full SOC2 report behind NDA, or (3) third-party pen-test summary (<=6 months) plus remediation notes.
Lena Torres: Pen-tests: prefer vendor-run windows but allow partner-provided reports if from an approved vendor (SecCheck, NightScan). If partner runs their own, require evidence of remediation and retest within 30 days.
Omar Aziz: Uploads: bucket = redwood-marketplace-evidence-prod. Path pattern: partners/{partner}/{listing}/{kind}/{YYYYMMDD}-{shortid}. Presign TTL 72h. Partners must POST metadata JSON after upload with keys: partner_name, listing_id, artifact_kind, owner_email, redaction_done.
Lena Torres: Redaction checklist (short): remove customer PII, mask internal IPs/DNS, redact specific customer names, remove internal-only URLs. Add redaction_notes.txt next to artifact describing redaction decisions.
Nadia Cohen: SI questionnaire: one page with checkboxes + short fields: deployment_type, data_flow, keys/credentials, third_party_services, pen_test_reference, SOC_reference, contact_name/email. Include a suggested announcement blurb partners can reuse.
ComplianceBot: Automated note: SOC2 expiry for "redwood-inference-hosted" = 2026-07-15. Reminder: begin renewal outreach 90 days prior.
Ethan Park: Legal blurb suggestion: "This integration uses Redwood Inference. Security practices and deployment details are available on request." Keep it minimal.
Nadia Cohen: Timeline: draft checklist + FAQ by Mon COB (2900000360). owners: Ethan = SOC/FAQ, Lena = pen-test rules + vendors, Omar = upload pattern + sample curl, Nadia = assemble + legal blurb. I'll compile and route to Legal & Security.
Omar Aziz: I'll add a tiny sample curl PUT with presigned URL and a verification step (sha256).
Lena Torres: I'll ping SecCheck for availability in May.
Ethan Park: I'll prepare the attestation summary and guidance on what counts as coverage for Dedicated vs Private.
Nadia Cohen: Thanks team ":thumbsup:". Please drop snippets into the partnership drive doc by Mon.
